verdict.rationale: The only product-specific evidence is the Build with URL feature, which can open Lovable with a prompt plus attached reference images and web pages. That is a thin route for handing an existing design to the builder. The docs line about designers moving beyond static mockups is positioning only and shows no import capability. missing for 10: any documented Figma file import, evidence that the builder faithfully implements an imported design, documentation of design-upload workflows inside the editor, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a designer, I can import a Figma file or existing design and have the builder implement it

citations.quote: create links that open Lovable with a prompt already written, and optionally with reference images and web pages attached
